Write a function that returns a value, and show the difference from print.

Supplied answer
def get_name():
    return "I am Surya" # sends the value back
message = get_name() # value is stored
print(message)
def show_name():
    print("I am Surya") # only displays, returns None
print(show_name()) # I am Surya then None
Note: return gives a value back to the caller; print only shows it on the screen.
